0D87: The slaves of God are good.
They who are Lord's serfs are good.
KGPG: O Nanak, their faces are radiant. ||4||3||141||
RPVN: Hey, soul: your only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
O man your only support is the Master's Name.
2HFX: Whatever else you do or make happen, the fear of death still hangs over you. ||1||Pause||
Whatever else is done and caused to be done, in them is the fear of Death's courier. Pause.
F5MX: He is not obtained by any other efforts.
By another effort the Lord is not obtained.
C3S5: By great good fortune, meditate on the Lord. ||1||
By very good luck, God is meditated upon.
T2P4: You may know hundreds of thousands of clever tricks,
Man may know lacs of devices,
P4F1: but not even one will be of any use at all hereafter. ||2||
but none carries even a sesame's weight hereafter.
Z3X0: Good deeds done in the pride of ego are swept away,
The good deeds done with proud intellect,
5YCU: Like the house of sand by water. ||3||
are swept off like the house of sand by water.
JTH1: When God the Merciful shows His Mercy,
When the Kind Lord shows mercy,
3AX1: Nanak receives the Naam in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||4||142||
Nanak receives the Name in the Society of Saints.
XRUH: I am a sacrifice, dedicated hundreds of thousands of times, to my Lord and Master.
I am devoted and a sacrifice, lacs of times to my Lord,
WQH7: His Name, and His Name alone, is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||
whose Name the Name alone is the prop of my life. Pause.
UUDY: You alone are the Doer, the Cause of causes.
You alone are the Doer and Prompter.
BJ5Q: You are the Support of all beings and creatures. ||1||
You are the Support of the mortals and other creatures.
U4WD: O God, You are my power, authority and youth.
My Lord Master, You are my domain and youth.
NGDN: You are absolute, without attributes, and also related, with the most sublime attributes. ||2||
You are the Related Lord and You the Absolute.
GQLQ: Here and hereafter, You are my Savior and Protector.
Here and There You are my Saviour.
HNU1: By Guru's Grace, some understand You. ||3||
By Guru's grace some rare one understands You.
UG7Y: God is All-knowing, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
The Omniscient Lord is the knower of hearts.
ZLRT: You are Nanak's strength and support. ||4||5||143||
You are the mainstay and strength of Nanak.
RFC0: Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
Meditate you on God, the Lord Master.
BGVT: In the Society of the Saints, He dwells in the mind; doubt, emotional attachment and fear are vanquished. ||1||Pause||
Through the Society of Saints, God abides in the mind and doubt secular attachment and dread are vanquished. Pause.
WAYF: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees are heard to proclaim
The Vedas, Puranas, and Simirtis proclaim,
VHGM: that the Lord's servant dwells as the highest of all. ||1||
that God's slaves are heard to abide the highest of all.
R13L: All places are filled with fear - know this well.
Know that all the places are awe stricken.
689D: Only the Lord's servants are free of fear. ||2||
The Lord's serfs are rendered fear-free.
SS59: Through eighty four lacs of existences the mortals wander.
R25R: God's people are not subject to birth and death. ||3||
Lords slaves come and go not.
L2T2: He has given up power, wisdom, cleverness and egotism.
Power wisdom, cleverness and egoism are shed,
QKBN: Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints. ||4||6||144||
as Nanak has caught hold of the refuge of God's Saints.
BVTE: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
My soul sing the praise of Pervading God's Name.
Z75Q: Serve the Lord continually and continuously; with each and every breath, meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Ever and ever serve God, and meditate on the Lord with every breath of yours. Pause.
YQFY: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind,
By the association of Saints, God dwells in the mind,
H6E2: and pain, suffering, darkness and doubt depart. ||1||
and distress pain, darkness and doubt flee.
FNS5: That humble being, who meditates on the Lord,
One who through Saints favour remembers God,
8VJG: By the Grace of the Saints, is not afflicted with pain. ||2||
that person is not afflicted with agony.
U4LX: Those to whom the Guru gives the Mantra of the Lord's Name,
He whom the Guru gives God's Name,
MNTG: are saved from the fire of Maya. ||3||
is saved from the mammon fire.
9DE8: Be kind to Nanak, O God;
O Lord show mercy to Nanak,
ERFJ: let the Lord's Name dwell within my mind and body. ||4||7||145||
that God's Name may abide within his mind and body.
AGBJ: With your tongue, chant the Name of the One Lord.
With your tongue repeat the One Name,
U1ME: In this world, it shall bring you peace, comfort and great joy; hereafter, it shall go with your soul, and shall be of use to you. ||1||Pause||
here it shall grant you comfort and great joy and hereafter it shall be of avail into your soul and keep its company. Pause.
NR56: The disease of your ego shall be eradicated.
Your ailment of ego shall be eradicated.
46QU: By Guru's Grace, practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||
By Guru's grace you shall enjoy secular and spiritual sovereignty.
XKTP: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord
The person who has tasted God's elixir,
QHXV: Those who have found the Lord, the Treasure of peace,
He who has obtained the treasure of peace of God,
6QQN: shall not go anywhere else again. ||3||
Y8MD: Those, to whom the Guru has given the Lord's Name, Har, Har
Whom the Guru gives the Name of Lord God,
DW6S: - O Nanak, their fears are removed. ||4||8||146||
O Nanak! his fear is removed.

MKFB: One who forgets the Lord's Name, suffers in pain.
Pain afflicts him who forgets the Lord's Name.
R8Y3: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and dwell upon the Lord, find the Ocean of virtue. ||1||Pause||
They who remember God by joining the society of Saints are an ocean of excellences. Pause.
RC0L: Those Gurmukhs whose hearts are filled with wisdom,
Who by Guru's grace has divine understanding within his mind,
A49Y: hold the nine treasures, and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas in the palms of their hands. ||1||
on his palm of hand are the nine treasures and supernatural powers.
Q61V: Those who know the Lord God as their Master,
He who knows Lord God as his Master with him,
LA6Q: there is no paucity of anything for him.
NRQ5: Those who realize the Creator Lord,
SRDY: enjoys all the comforts and pleasures.
ZGGR: Those whose inner homes are filled with the Lord's wealth
Says Nanak the distress departs in the company of him,
NVRT: - says Nanak, in their company, pain departs. ||4||9||147||
in whose heart-home God's wealth is treasured up.
L1UC: Your pride is so great, but what about your origins?
O mortal great is your pride from such as humble origin.
27EX: You cannot remain, no matter how much you try to hold on. ||1||Pause||
You are not to stay however much you mayest grasp the world. Pause.
RMWM: That which is forbidden by the Vedas and the Saints - with that, you are in love.
What is forbidden by the Vedas and Saints with that O mortal you bearest love.
BJV2: Like the gambler losing the game of chance, you are held in the power of sensory desires. ||1||
As the game of gamble keeps attached to itself even the loser gambler so do the sense-passion conquer and hold you in bondage.
Z0HF: The One who is All-powerful to empty out and fill up - you have no love for His Lotus Feet.
One who is completely potent to empty and to fill you are devoid of the love of His lotus feet.
AU9P: O Nanak, I have been saved, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. I have been blessed by the Treasure of Mercy. ||2||10||148||
The Treasure of Mercy has given me Nanak the Society of Saints by which I am saved.
JNRB: I am the slave of my Lord and Master.
I am an attendant of my Master.
46TX: I eat whatever God gives me. ||1||Pause||
I eat what is given to me in charity by the Lord. Pause.
GPPN: Such is my Lord and Master.
Such is my Husband O men.
DCW9: In an instant, He creates and embellishes. ||1||
In a moment He creates and embellishes.
AYS5: I do that work which pleases my Lord and Master.
I do the work which pleases my Lord.
6CBX: I sing the songs of God's glory, and His wondrous play. ||2||
I sing the songs of Lord's praise and His wonderous plays.
2VXC: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's Prime Minister;
I have sought the protection of Lord's Minister (the Guru).
1NLQ: beholding Him, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||3||
By seeing him my mind has grown fortitude.
Y5KN: The One Lord is my support, the One is my steady anchor.
One Lord's refuge and One's support (Nanak) seeks,
S1NB: Servant Nanak is engaged in the Lord's work. ||4||11||149||
Slave Nanak is engaged in God's service alone.
MH84: Is there anyone, who can shatter his ego,
Is there such a one who may shatter his ego,
YEVL: and turn his mind away from this sweet Maya? ||1||Pause||
and from this sweet mammon turn away this soul of him? Pause.
EXX0: Humanity is in spiritual ignorance; people see things that do not exist.
Man has become spiritually ignorant and seeks that what exists not.
VTE0: The night is dark and gloomy; how will the morning dawn? ||1||
The night is dark and gloomy. What is the way by which morning may dawn for him?
FZ4X: Wandering, wandering all around, I have grown weary; trying all sorts of things, I have been searching.
Wandering and roaming about I have grown weary. Adopting various ways I have searched the Lord.
6UVR: Says Nanak, He has shown mercy to me; I have found the treasure of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||12||150||
Says Nanak, the Lord has shown mercy to me and I have gained the treasure of Saints Society.
VW46: He is the Wish-fulfilling Jewel, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||1||Pause||
The Lord is the Desire-fulfilling Gem and Embodiment of Mercy. Pause.
GNXE: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; Meditating in remembrance on Him, peace is obtained. ||1||
The Lofty Lord is merciful to the meek, by whose meditation peace is procured.
1MQ6: The Wisdom of the Undying Primal Being is beyond comprehension. Hearing His Praises, millions of sins are erased. ||2||
The knowledge of the Immortal Lord is beyond comprehension. By hearing His praise millions of sins are effaced.
FLDN: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless Nanak with Your kindness, that he may repeat the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||13||151||
O Master the Treasure of benevolence show mercy, to Nanak that he may repeat the Lord God's Name.
DJB0: O my mind, in the Sanctuary of God, peace is found.
O my soul in Lord's refuge peace is attained.
UJAB: That day, when the Giver of life and peace is forgotten - that day passes uselessly. ||1||Pause||
The day when the Giver of life and solace is forgotten that day passes in vain. Pause.
HLSZ: You have come as a guest for one short night, and yet you hope to live for many ages.
You have come as guest of one night, yet you have extended the hope of living for many ages.
K66T: Households, mansions and wealth - whatever is seen, is like the shade of a tree. ||1||
Houses, mansions and riches whatever is seen is like the shade of a tree.
WSWS: My body, wealth, and all my gardens and property shall all pass away.
My body, my entire wealth, gardens and property all shall pass away.
YRWF: You have forgotten your Lord and Master, the Great Giver. In an instant, these shall belong to somebody else. ||2||
You have forgotten Lord the Giver In an instant these things shall belong to else one.

0C3Y: You wear white clothes and take cleansing baths, and anoint yourself with sandalwood oil.
You takest bath and puttest on white clothes and perfumest yourself with otto of sandal.
8ECM: But you do not remember the Fearless, Formless Lord - you are like an elephant bathing in the mud. ||3||
You rememberest not the Fearless the Formless Lord. Your bath is like the elephant's bathing.
QVEL: When God becomes merciful, He leads you to meet the True Guru; all peace is in the Name of the Lord.
When God becomes merciful He introduces you to the True Guru, then all peace abides in God's Name.
MH8Y: The Guru has liberated me from bondage; servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||14||152||
Slave Nanak chants God's glories. The Guru has unlocked his fetters and he is emancipated.
88RG: O my mind, dwell always upon the Guru, Guru, Guru.
My mind ever ponder you on the Great God incarnate Guru.
HQ0V: The Guru has made the jewel of this human life prosperous and fruitful. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||
The invaluable birth the Guru has made fruitful to his sight, I am a sacrifice. Pause.
N43U: As many breaths and morsels as you take, O my mind - so many times, sing His Glorious Praises.
As many breaths and morsels do you take, O may soul, so many times do you sing Lord's praise.
Y3KZ: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then this wisdom and understanding is obtained. ||1||
When my True Guru becomes merciful, then alone this understanding and intellect is obtained.
5M5U: O my mind, taking the Naam, you shall be released from the bondage of death, and the peace of all peace will be found.
By taking the Name, O my soul, you shall be released from the bondage of the Death's courier, and obtain the comfort of all the comforts.
UNQF: Serving your Lord and Master, the True Guru, the Great Giver, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||2||
By serving the beneficent Lord, the True Guru, the heart desired boons are obtained.
3E3B: The Name of the Creator is your beloved friend and child; it alone shall go along with you, O my mind.
My mind, the Name of the Creator is your beloved friend and son, and it shall go with you.
HEX9: So serve your True Guru, and you shall receive the Name from the Guru. ||3||
Perform you the service of your True Guru. From the Guru, the Name is received in the lap.
CZ1M: When God, the Merciful Guru, showered His Mercy upon me, all my anxieties were dispelled.
When, my Master, the kind Guru, showed mercy to me, all my anxieties did end.
N5KX: Nanak has found the peace of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. All his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||15||153||
Nanak has obtained peace by singing the praises of God, and all his sufferings have ceased.
5DDP: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. Through the grace of the True Guru He is obtained.
A6C3: The thirst of only a few is quenched. ||1||Pause||
The thirst (desire) of only a few is quenched (stilled). Pause.
PCW6: People may accumulate hundreds of thousands, millions, tens of millions, and yet the mind is not restrained. They only yearn for more and more. ||1||
Man amasses millions and lacs of millions but restrains not his mind, he longs for more and more.
LXCM: They may have all sorts of beautiful women, but still, they commit adultery in the homes of others. They do not distinguish between good and bad. ||2||
He possesses beautiful ladies of so many Kinds, but still he commits adultery in other's houses. Between bad and good he distinguishes not.
XYHK: They wander around lost, trapped in the myriad bonds of Maya; they do not sing the Praises of the Treasure of Virtue. Their minds are engrossed in poison and corruption. ||3||
Caused to wader by several bonds of mammon, he wanders about, and sings not the praises of the Treasure of excellences. His mind is engrossed in evil deeds.
7SZ2: Those, to whom the Lord shows His Mercy, remain dead while yet alive. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the ocean of Maya. O Nanak, those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||154||
He, to whom Lord shows mercy, remains dead in life, and joining the Society of Saints, crosses the sea of mammon. Nanak, that man is exonerated in God's court.
WKZS: The Lord is the essence of all. ||1||Pause||
God is the essence of everything. Pause.
QHDC: Some practice Yoga, some indulge in pleasures; some live in spiritual wisdom, some live in meditation. Some are bearers of the staff. ||1||
Some practice science of yoga, some indulgence, some Divine Knowledge, and some meditation. Some like to be staff bearer hermits.
PZNZ: Some chant in meditation, some practice deep, austere meditation; some worship Him in adoration, some practice daily rituals. Some live the life of a wanderer. ||2||
Some love lip repetition, some penance, some worship, burnt offerings and daily rites. Some like a wandering existence.
A9V1: Some live by the shore, some live on the water; some study the Vedas. Nanak loves to worship the Lord. ||3||2||155||
Some love the shore, some the water and some the study of Vedas. To Nanak, the devotional service of God is dear.
GAFH: To sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is my treasure. ||1||Pause||
To sing the praise of the Lord is my treasure. Pause.
CT0H: You are my delight, You are my praise. You are my beauty, You are my love. O God, You are my hope and support. ||1||
You are my delight, You my praise, You my beauty and You my love. You, O Lord, are my hope and shelter.
1A6K: You are my pride, You are my wealth. You are my honor, You are my breath of life. The Guru has repaired that which was broken. ||2||
You are my pride, You are my wealth, You are my honour and You are my very life. The Guru has united me with You, from whom I had parted.
9XVT: You are in the household, and You are in the forest. You are in the village, and You are in the wilderness. Nanak: You are near, so very near! ||3||3||156||
You are in home, You in forest, You in village, and You in wilderness. Near, how near are You, O Lord.

EMR9: I am intoxicated, intoxicated with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
I am intoxicated, intoxicated with God's love. Pause.
7L11: I drink it in - I am drunk with it. The Guru has given it to me in charity. My mind is drenched with it. ||1||
That (love wine) I drink and with that I am inebriated. The Guru has given me that as alms. With that my soul is imbued.
C3HT: It is my furnace, it is the cooling plaster. It is my love, it is my longing. My mind knows it as peace. ||2||
That Lord is my furnace. That my cooling plaster. That my cup, and That my longing.
S7QD: I enjoy intuitive peace, and I play in bliss; the cycle of reincarnation is ended for me, and I am merged with the Lord. Nanak is pierced through with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||4||157||
I make merry with the Lord, and play in bliss. Ended is my round, and I am blended with Him. With Guru's hymns, Nanak is pierced.
SD3W: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the favour of the True Guru, He is known.
XBUU: Chant the Lord's Name; O my friend, chant it. Hereafter, the path is terrifying and treacherous. ||1||Pause||
Repeat, repeat you, O friend the Name of God. Hereafter, you shall tread the arduous and dreadful path. Pause.
G32N: Serve, serve, forever serve the Lord. Death hangs over your head.
Serve, serve and, ever serve the Lord. Death hangs over your head.
EV1F: Do seva, selfless service, for the Holy Saints, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||
Perform you the service of the Saints. O like this the Death's noose is cut.
SLJ3: You may make burnt offerings, sacrificial feasts and pilgrimages to sacred shrines in egotism, but your corruption only increases.
In the ego of performing burnt offerings, sacrificial feasts, and pilgrimages, the sins multiply.
PYA5: You are subject to both heaven and hell, and you are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||
Man becomes subjects to hell and heaven, both, and is born again and again.
NRLE: The realm of Shiva, the realms of Brahma and Indra as well - no place anywhere is permanent.
The realm of Shiva and the realms of Brahma and Indra no place is ever stable.
WBDD: Without serving the Lord, there is no peace at all. The faithless cynic comes and goes in reincarnation. ||3||
Without God's service, there is no peace. Becoming the worshipper of mammon, man continues coming and going.
89T7: As the Guru has taught me, so have I spoken.
As the Guru did instruct me, so have I proclaimed.
7YAL: Says Nanak, listen, people: sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and you shall be saved. ||4||1||158||
Says the hearken O Man sing the praise of God, and you are emancipated.
T2QL: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God, By the favour of the True Guru, He is known.
R1Z4: Adopting the innocent mind of a child, I have found peace.
O adopting a child's mind I have attained peace.
MHB2: Joy and sorrow, profit and loss, birth and death, pain and pleasure - they are all the same to my consciousness, since I met the Guru. ||1||Pause||
By meeting the Guru joy and sorrow profit and loss birth and death pain and pleasure have become alike to my mind. Pause.
7MCF: As long as I plotted and planned things, I was full of frustration.
So long as I planned and contrived something till then I remained brimful with anxieties.
BKDW: When I met the Kind, Perfect Guru, then I obtained bliss so easily. ||1||
When I met the kind Perfect Guru, I easily, obtained bliss then.
GFC4: The more clever tricks I tried, the more bonds I was saddled with.
The more the deeds, I did through cleverness, the more the fetters I was loaded with.
UVPG: When the Holy Saint placed His Hand upon my forehead, then I was liberated. ||2||
When the Saint (Guru) placed his hand on my forehead, then was I emancipated.
9RC2: As long as I claimed, "Mine, mine!", I was surrounded by wickedness and corruption.
As long as I asserted "This is mine, this is mine ", till then I was surrounded by wickedness.
HSQJ: But when I dedicated my mind, body and intellect to my Lord and Master, then I began to sleep in peace. ||3||
When I dedicated my mind, body and intellect to the Lord, I slept in peace, then.
C0KL: As long as I walked along, carrying the load, I continued to pay the fine.
As long as I walked along carrying bundle of mammon, till then, I continued to pay the fine.
TMLE: But I threw away that bundle, when I met the Perfect Guru; O Nanak, then I became fearless. ||4||1||159||
When I, Nanak threw away the bundle, I met the Perfect Guru, and was rendered fearless then.
LUTG: I have renounced my desires; I have renounced them.
O my friend my desires I have eschewed and renounced.
ZPF8: I have renounced them; meeting the Guru, I have renounced them.
By meeting the Guru, I have left and forsaken them.
RD1C: All peace, joy, happiness and pleasures have come since I surrendered to the Will of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
I have obtained all the comforts, joys, rejoicing and relishes by obeying world-Lord's will. Pause.

NCYY: Honor and dishonor are the same to me; I have placed my forehead upon the Guru's Feet.
For me, honour and dishonour both are alike. My forehead I have placed on Guru's feet.
0DN0: Wealth does not excite me, and misfortune does not disturb me; I have embraced love for my Lord and Master. ||1||
Wealth pleases, and calamity discomforts me not, for I have embraced love for the Lord.
2FMD: The One Lord and Master dwells in the home; He is seen in the wilderness as well.
The One Lord abides in home, and is seen in wilderness as well.
TU34: I have become fearless; the Saint has removed my doubts. The All-knowing Lord is pervading everywhere. ||2||
The saint has shed my doubt and I have become fearless. The Omniscient Lord is fully filling all.
H7ZJ: Whatever the Creator does, my mind is not troubled.
Whatever work the Creator does, seems not unpleasant to my mind.
Q6A3: By the Grace of the Saints and the Company of the Holy, my sleeping mind has been awakened. ||3||
By the grace of the congregation of the righteous and the Saints my sleeping soul has awakened.
SU98: Servant Nanak seeks Your Support; he has come to Your Sanctuary.
Servant Nanak has sought Your support, and entered Yours sanctuary.
3CDJ: In the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he enjoys intuitive peace; pain no longer touches him. ||4||2||160||
In the love of Name, Nanak enjoys supreme bliss, and pain touches him not again.
DU1R: I have found the jewel of my Beloved within my mind.
I have found, found within my mind, my gem-like Beloved.
GJ9X: My body is cooled, my mind is cooled and soothed, and I am absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
My body is rendered cool, my soul is rendered cool and I am absorbed in the Word of the True Guru. Pause.
BTTX: My hunger has departed, my thirst has totally departed, and all my anxiety is forgotten.
My hunger has departed, my desires have all disappeared, and my entire anxiety is over.
29HW: The Perfect Guru has placed His Hand upon my forehead; conquering my mind, I have conquered the whole world. ||1||
The Perfect Guru has placed his hand on my forehead, and with the conquest of my mind I have conquered the whole world.
KHBY: Satisfied and satiated, I remain steady within my heart, and now, I do not waver at all.
Sated and satiated, I remain within my mind, and now, I waver not.
LKA1: The True Guru has given me the inexhaustible treasure; it never decreases, and never runs out. ||2||
An inexhaustible treasure, the True Guru has given me. It suffers no paucity, not gets emptied.
3C5B: Listen to this wonder, O Siblings of Destiny: the Guru has given me this understanding.
Hear a wonderful thing, O brother, the Guru has imparted to me such an understanding,
ML2E: I threw off the veil of illusion, when I met my Lord and Master; then, I forgot my jealousy of others. ||3||
that when, throwing off the curtain, I met my Lord, I forgot to be jealous of others.
T4G1: This is a wonder which cannot be described. They alone know it, who have tasted it.
This is a wonder which cannot be described. He alone realises who quaffs it.
Q9VN: Says Nanak, the Truth has been revealed to me. The Guru has given me the treasure; I have taken it and enshrined it within my heart. ||4||3||161||
Says Nanak, the Truth is revealed to me. Taking the Name wealth from the Guru. I have enshrined it in my heart.
0Y1D: Those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the King, are saved.
One is saved in the refuge of Lord, the King.
0TE2: All other people, in the mansion of Maya, fall flat on their faces on the ground. ||1||Pause||
All other people, holding worldly courts, fall flat on the ground. Pause.
S95K: The great men have studied the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas, and they have said this:
The great men after the study of Shastras, Simiritis and Vedas have said,
YRFY: "Without the Lord's meditation, there is no emancipation, and no one has ever found peace." ||1||
that without God's meditation there is no emancipation, nor has any one attained peace.
SL7S: People may accumulate the wealth of the three worlds, but the waves of greed are still not subdued.
Man may amass the wealth of the three worlds, but his waves of avarice slake not.
FRXN: Without devotional worship of the Lord, where can anyone find stability? People wander around endlessly. ||2||
Without God's Meditation, where can stableness be obtained, and the mortal ever wanders about?
PRV1: People engage in all sorts of mind-enticing pastimes, but their passions are not fulfilled.
Man engages in various fascinating recreations, but his desires are not sated.
SUU1: They burn and burn, and are never satisfied; without the Lord's Name, it is all useless. ||3||
He ever burns, and is never quenched. Without Lord's Name all the things are vain.
ZMV0: Chant the Name of the Lord, my friend; this is the essence of perfect peace.
Repeat you the Name of God, O my friend. This is the essence of perfect happiness.
A0QN: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, birth and death are ended. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||4||162||
